summary.text: Jim Rigby is a Republican state representative from Cambria County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 71 since December 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former police chief, he is serving his fourth term.

paragraphs.text: Rigby is a lifelong Johnstown resident who, according to his official biography, spent more than four decades in community service, beginning as a volunteer fireman before becoming a police officer.
He was named Ferndale Borough's chief of police in 2015, served on Ferndale Borough Council for 24 years, six of them as president, and worked 29 years for the American Red Cross.
He previously served as board president of the Women's Help Center and on the Cambria County Sexual Assault Response Team.

For the 2025-26 session Rigby serves on the House Appropriations Committee, where he leads the Subcommittee on Criminal Justice, and on the Communications and Technology, Judiciary and Liquor Control committees.
His biography says he plans to focus on the state's opioid epidemic and blighted homes.
Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate in the general election for the district.
